highlights.title: Somalia looks to the future as the UN's political mission closes
highlights.summary: “The story of the UN's political engagement in Somalia has been one of persistence, partnership and adaptation,” Raisedon Zenenga, the UN Secretary-General's Deputy Special Representative for Somalia has said, as three decades of UN political missions in the Horn of Africa country comes to an e...

highlights.title: France braces for Halloween protests, shops board up storefronts
highlights.summary: France on Saturday braced for a third weekend of protests coinciding with Halloween, as shops boarded up and authorities scrambled to prevent a repeat of the street violence that swept the country two weeks ago.

highlights.title: US, South Korea, Japan call for ‘complete denuclearisation’ of North Korea
highlights.summary: The joint statement comes as US President Donald Trump seeks a new meeting with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

highlights.title: Liu Yandong, Rare Woman Among China’s Political Elite, Dies at 80
highlights.summary: The former vice premier was one of just six women to have served on the Chinese Communist Party’s elite Politburo, though she was excluded from the top ranks of power.

highlights.title: IA não traz retorno financeiro para a maioria das empresas, diz economista
